# ztna_connector_list (Data Source)

Retrieves a listing of config items.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) The device of the item.
- `filters` (String) String to filter list results by searching one specified field of an object. Multiple filters can be specified.
- `folder` (String) The folder of the item. Default: Shared.
- `limit` (Number) The max number of items to return. Default: 200.
- `name` (String) The name of the item.
- `offset` (Number) The offset of the first item to return.
- `search` (String) String to filter list results by. Is searched over multiple fields in each object. Multiple searches can be specified.
- `snippet` (String) The snippet of the item.
- `sort` (String) List of fields from item response to sort by.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) The data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `total` (Number) The total number of items.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Name of the connector.

It can only be 64 characters long
and contain unicode text, space, dash, or underscore, or period.

Read-Only:

- `created_time` (String) Created time
- `description` (String) Description of the connector.
- `group` (String) The connector group id
- `oid` (String) Id of the entry.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `updated_time` (String) Updated time
